concepts.label: Indexing on document metadata fields (via META())
concepts.note: a feature/capability page describing which META() properties (cas, expiration, id) can be indexed, not itself a distinct statement

relations.subject: n1ql:indexing-metadata-fields
relations.note: structural link from an existing Markdown xref to nestedops.md
relations.evidence: To index a selected metadata field, you must use a [nested expression](nestedops.md#field-selection) containing the `META()` function and the required property, for example `META().id`.

notable_absence.finding: This page gives no version at which META()-property indexing became available, and no privilege section, despite describing a constraint that is enforced at index-creation time ('If you attempt to build an index on a metadata field that's not indexable, an error is returned') — a similarly enforced, similarly consequential constraint on ALTER INDEX is documented there with an explicit RBAC role and version gate.
